Ava (Partnerships): quick sync 94 need to push first-pass marketplace listings for AWS/GCP/Azure into staging this week. scope: trial SKU, short copy, pricing map, and deploy artifacts. who can lead?
Raj (Product): I can own packaging + pricing mapping. will draft SKU matrix today.
Ava (Partnerships): include recommended trial length and entitlements (rate limits, hosted vs dedicated flags).
Raj (Product): question: single SKU with region variants or separate per-cloud SKUs?
Miguel (CloudOps): recommend per-cloud SKUs 94 keeps AMI/container builds and region metadata simple for portals.
Jo (Engineering): note: private deploy artifact names differ for onprem vs marketplace. I'll add a build target to produce marketplace-compatible tarball and container manifest.
Tanya (Legal): need EULA snippet and partner contact info. confirm if trial terms require EU language variants.
Ava (Partnerships): Raj 94 add EULA placeholder in SKU matrix and mark EU localization required.
Raj (Product): added. should we expose a metered usage field for tokens in pricing tiers?
Miguel (CloudOps): yes 94 marketplace metering for tokens is awkward. document both 'marketplace-visible price' and 'internal metering flag'. for AWS/Azure we can expose a usage dimension but billing mapping is off-platform.
Jo (Engineering): AWS requires AMI IDs + role ARN for listing verification. I can provision a staging AMI and share IDs.
Ava (Partnerships): @marketplace-bot share publisher checklist link.
marketplace-bot: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/publisher-checklist 94 includes IAM templates, screenshot specs, listing copy guidelines.
Tanya (Legal): I'll review compliance checklist for gov/reg markets and flag publish blockers (data residency, audit logs, export controls) by EOD.
Raj (Product): I'll upload SKU matrix to the checklist doc and add tile copy + three screenshots.
Jo (Engineering): screenshot sizes: 1280x720 + architecture diagram. I'll make a lightweight diagram.
Miguel (CloudOps): testing plan: need one test account per cloud pre-seeded with sample token allowance and dummy Blob/S3/GCS storage to validate flows. I can spin these up 94 need account names.
Ava (Partnerships): name accounts redwood-marketplace-staging-<cloud>. Miguel 94 send creds via 1Password.
Miguel (CloudOps): will do.
Tanya (Legal): do we need an export control statement for EU listing? some portals ask about crypto/export.
Ava (Partnerships): yes include a non-export-restricted one-liner. Tanya 94 drop snippet.
Tanya (Legal): "This product does not include cryptographic functionality beyond standard transport encryption and is compliant with applicable export control laws."
Raj (Product): timeline: artifacts by Thu AM -> staging publish Thu EOD, is that realistic?
Jo (Engineering): can produce artifacts by Thu AM. Miguel can prep accounts by Thu noon. Tanya to finish review by Thu EOD.
Ava (Partnerships): aim for staging publish Thu EOD. blockers: legal hold, security review, missing screenshots.
marketplace-bot: reminder: publisher accounts often trigger manual verification; plan +48h for portal review after submit.
Jo (Engineering): adding CI jobs: `make marketplace-package` and `make publish-staging` with dry-run. snippet: ```bash
# dry-run
make marketplace-package DRY_RUN=1
```
Miguel (CloudOps): I'll add deploy playbook + one-click smoke test: create instance, run healthcheck, request token generation.
Ava (Partnerships): owners: Raj -> packaging & copy; Jo -> artifacts/CI; Miguel -> staging infra; Tanya -> legal signoff. I'll coordinate portal submission and marketing blurb.
Raj (Product): adding owners to checklist doc now.
Tanya (Legal): sending EULA snippet + export line now.
Ava (Partnerships): thanks all. I'll check in Fri AM to confirm status and schedule portal submission window. :rocket:
